title: Elements, equality and vanishing in a filtered colimit of modules
statement: Let $R$ be a ring, $I$ a small filtered category (for instance a directed set) and $i\mapsto M_i$ a functor from $I$ to the category of $R$-modules, with a colimit $(M,(\iota_i)_i)$ in that category [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Then: (1) every element of $M$ is $\iota_i(x)$ for some $i$ and some $x\in M_i$; (2) for $x\in M_i$, $y\in M_j$ one has $\iota_i(x)=\iota_j(y)$ if and only if there are an object $k$ and morphisms $f:i\to k$, $g:j\to k$ with $M(f)(x)=M(g)(y)$; in particular $\iota_i(x)=0$ if and only if $M(f)(x)=0$ for some morphism $f:i\to k$ (for a directed set: $\mu_{ki}(x)=0$ for some $k\ge i$).
